name: beybladexmeta-analytics
description: Monorepo root. frontend/ (Vite + React), backend/ (Express, being strangled) and backend-py/ (FastAPI, taking over route by route).

scripts.db:psql: docker exec -it beyblade-dev-db psql -U postgres -d beyblade_tracker
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down -v && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,magenta "npm run dev:py" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && uv sync --directory backend-py
